Markets.title: Copper hits over six-month high as LME supply concerns mount
Markets.summary: Copper prices hit a six-month high on Monday due to a significant drop in London Metal Exchange inventories. Other industrial metals also gained value as the U.S. dollar weakened.

Markets.title: Ahead of Market: 10 things that will decide stock market action on Tuesday
Markets.summary: Indian stock indices extended their losses for a fifth consecutive session, driven by declining values in the Sensex and Nifty. Market analysts noted that crude oil prices, tensions in the Strait of Hormuz, and upcoming Federal Reserve minutes will be the primary factors influencing Tuesday's market direction.

Markets.title: ICICI Bank raises $750 million as Indian banks tap dollar bond market
Markets.summary: ICICI Bank raised $750 million through a five-year dollar bond issuance priced at 105 basis points over US Treasuries. This marks the bank's second dollar bond sale in a month, as other Indian institutions like Kotak Mahindra Bank and Yes Bank prepare similar international offerings.

Markets.title: Bain Capital sells 5.64% unitholding in Embassy Office Parks REIT for Rs 2,325 crore
Markets.summary: Bain Capital sold its 5.64% stake in Embassy Office Parks REIT for Rs 2,325 crore by offloading over 53 million units. Following the transaction, Embassy REIT announced plans to acquire and develop millions of square feet of new office space while reporting a 17% annual increase in net operating income.

Markets.title: EyePoint's drug for age-related eye disease fails late-stage trial, shares tank 70%
Markets.summary: EyePoint's experimental drug Duravyu failed a late-stage trial for a serious age-related eye disease, causing the company's shares to tank 70%. The setback halts EyePoint's plans to compete with Regeneron's Eylea treatment while the company prepares for a new trial.

Markets.title: Following live trading strategies on social media? Sebi has a warning for you
Markets.summary: Sebi warned investors against following live trading strategies and stock tips shared on social media. The market regulator stated that these sessions may be run by unregistered advisors and urged people to deal only with Sebi-registered intermediaries.

Geo-Political.title: Trump threatens to bomb US ally Oman if it 'gets in the way' over Iran deal
Geo-Political.summary: President Trump threatened to bomb Oman if the US ally interferes with his administration's approach to Iran. The threat occurs as a 60-day deadline for peace negotiations expires, while Oman conducts separate talks with Iran regarding the Strait of Hormuz.

Geo-Political.title: Russia and Ukraine trade more deadly strikes
Geo-Political.summary: Moscow reported nine deaths from Ukrainian strikes over a 24-hour period. Kyiv reported four deaths resulting from Russian attacks during the same timeframe.

Geo-Political.title: Trump says US to reduce military drills with South Korea after it stayed out of Iran war
Geo-Political.summary: President Trump announced the U.S. will reduce military drills with South Korea. He cited his strong relationship with North Korea's leader and South Korea's decision not to participate in the Iran war as reasons for the reduction.

Geo-Political.title: Russia's prominent anti-war politician jailed for 11 years
Geo-Political.summary: Prominent Russian anti-war politician Lev Schlosberg has been sentenced to 11 years in prison for allegedly discrediting the country's army. Schlosberg condemned the verdict, stating it is punishment for his political stance.

Geo-Political.title: US hiker dies after being struck by lightning on Mount Etna
Geo-Political.summary: A 30-year-old American hiker died after being struck by lightning on Mount Etna. The incident occurred on the active volcano in Italy after a thunderstorm suddenly developed.

Geo-Political.title: Trump envoy Kushner meets Netanyahu after Hamas talks on peace plan
Geo-Political.summary: US President Trump's son-in-law, Jared Kushner, met with Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu. The meeting aimed to secure Israeli support for a US-backed Gaza peace plan following discussions with Hamas.

AI & Tech.summary: An author discovered their WordPress SaaS course was recommended as the top result when asking ChatGPT for the best course in that category. This unexpected placement occurred without any paid advertising or traditional search engine optimization.

AI & Tech.summary: LimeWire is a generative AI platform that allows users to create various types of AI content. The platform also provides creators with tools to share and monetize their work.

Data & Insights.title: India’s overall unemployment rate falls in July; joblessness rises in urban centres but eases in rural areas
Data & Insights.summary: According to the Periodic Labour Force Survey (PLFS), India's overall unemployment rate decreased in July. While joblessness dropped in rural areas, it increased in urban centers.

Data & Insights.title: Mint Explainer | Indian consumers are spending again. Can it last?
Data & Insights.summary: Indian consumer spending grew in the first quarter, driven by rural demand, premium products, and quick commerce. However, higher input costs and food inflation threaten to disrupt this ongoing recovery.

Data & Insights.title: Currency in circulation, ATM withdrawals, 10 countries, hinterland India… How UPI made a dent in the financial universe
Data & Insights.summary: India's UPI transaction value has surged to equal 70% of the country's currency in circulation. This rapid growth is driven by widespread adoption extending well beyond major economic hubs into hinterland regions.

Data & Insights.title: India’s $20 trillion economy by 2036: The 5 growth engines that could unlock its next leap
Data & Insights.summary: An Equirus policy report states that India can reach a $20 trillion economy by 2036. This growth will be driven by five key areas: human capital, markets, services, governance, and currency.

Data & Insights.title: The week in charts: Price pressures, youth unemployment, chairman exit
Data & Insights.summary: This weekly compilation uses easy-to-read charts to provide data-driven insights into top stories reported by Mint. The covered topics include price pressures, youth unemployment, and a chairman exit.

Data & Insights.title: India's WPI inflation cools marginally to 9.78% in July as fuel prices ease
Data & Insights.summary: India's Wholesale Price Index (WPI) inflation dipped slightly to 9.78% in July due to a moderation in fuel and power inflation to 20.05%. However, inflation for primary articles and manufactured products accelerated during the same period.

India.title: Life Convict In Rs 1 Crore Kidnapping Case Arrested After 26 Years
India.summary: A life convict in a one crore rupee kidnapping case was arrested after evading police for 26 years. He had hidden in Rishikesh before moving to Dehradun in 2001, where he assumed a new identity and started a fresh life.

India.title: Who Is Shahzad Bhatti? Pak-Backed Handler's Network Busted, Many Arrested
India.summary: Indian security agencies busted a Pakistan-backed ISI terror network led by Shahzad Bhatti, arresting 253 people across 14 states. This operation successfully thwarted a major pre-Independence Day terror plot.

India.title: BJP's New Team: The Big Ins, Outs And Replacements
India.summary: The Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP) has announced a reshuffle of its leadership team. This reorganization aims to strengthen the party's structure across various states and social groups ahead of upcoming elections.

India.title: Chemistry Classroom To BJP War Room: Meet Amit Malviya's Successor Deepak Mhaskey
India.summary: Deepak Mhaskey has succeeded Amit Malviya as a key figure in the BJP. According to party sources, Mhaskey is a senior leader from Raipur, Chhattisgarh.

India.title: Big Role For Hemang Joshi In BJP's 'Gen Z' Connect -- Replacing Tejasvi Surya
India.summary: The BJP has appointed Vadodara MP Hemang Joshi as the new national president of the Bharatiya Janata Yuva Morcha (BJYM). He replaces outgoing chief Tejasvi Surya in the role aimed at connecting with younger voters.

India.title: 'Bhangra After Knee Replacement': AAP Health Card Video Triggers Political Row
India.summary: A promotional video for the AAP health card featuring elderly people doing Bhangra after knee replacement surgery sparked a political controversy. Opposition leaders questioned the authenticity of the recoveries shown in the footage.

General.title: Trump threatens to bomb US ally Oman if it 'gets in the way' over Iran deal
General.summary: President Trump threatened to bomb U.S. ally Oman if the nation interferes with his plans regarding Iran. The threat occurred as a 60-day window for peace negotiations expired, while Oman was holding separate talks with Iran to reopen the Strait of Hormuz.

General.title: Burnham exchanged messages with person posing as Trump's chief of staff
General.summary: Andy Burnham exchanged messages with an individual who was posing as Donald Trump's chief of staff. Downing Street has declined to comment on this security breach, which was originally reported by Politico.

General.title: Parents pushed to breaking point by Child Maintenance Service, BBC told
General.summary: Mothers report struggling to force ex-partners to pay child support through the Child Maintenance Service. Meanwhile, fathers state the service has incorrectly billed them thousands of pounds.

General.title: Emotional farewell to 'global, iconic superstar' Bonnie Tyler
General.summary: Fans, friends and family travel to Swansea to pay tribute to Total Eclipse of the Heart singer.

General.title: Rain on way for UK with temperatures to drop to overnight lows of 3C in some places
General.summary: The UK weather will turn wetter and cooler this week following a summer of heatwaves and drought. Temperatures are forecasted to drop to overnight lows of 3C in some areas.

General.title: Princess Eugenie announces name of baby daughter
General.summary: Princess Eugenie gave birth to her third child, a baby daughter, at a hospital in Lisbon, Portugal, earlier this month. The newborn weighed 6 pounds and 9 ounces, and the couple has now announced her name.
